title: Mobile home refinement code checks passed
summary: A more compact welcome section, clearer actions and progress, and a slimmer bottom navigation improve the mobile home layout.

changes.detail: Reduced hero spacing and heading size, shortened welcome text in all three languages, differentiated primary and secondary actions, and stacked actions on narrow or enlarged-text screens.
Grouped progress counts into a bordered strip with separators; removed zero-padding. Compacted the next-lesson card with a green accent and corrected its Arabic arrow direction.
Reduced navigation padding and icon spacing while retaining accessible touch targets and RTL order. Preserved hidden Change History.

validation.name: TypeScript and focused lint
validation.detail: npm.cmd run typecheck and ESLint for StudyDashboard and BottomTabBar passed after final edits.

validation.name: History preservation
validation.detail: All six history tests passed and the manifest check preserved 181 reports before adding this follow-up.

validation.name: Visual and device verification
validation.detail: No browser screenshot or physical device check performed. Responsive layout changes require visual confirmation in the running app. No deployment.
